description: Restoring the chosen tree's elided terminators can reject every reading. Under lazy, a closes before B is read, so a B beats A B. Written back, KU after A fails the lookahead of a, and A B has no alternative with KU. With no derivation of the restored text, no two readings exist to report, so the check passes (engine §7).
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution lazy elision-only
%elidable KU
%rule text a B | A B
%rule a $x(A) [KU]
%conditions ¬begins(after($x), k)
%rule k KU
